titre: A design system that blocks nothing is just a suggestion, for humans and agents alike
essentiel: Governance: Florian Gampert wants a system that "complains" (build, linter, review), and Kitty Brown puts a well-equipped agent's reliability at 90-95%.
The design system becomes the antidote to AI's generic output: Claude Design imports one in 3 steps, and The Human Layer calls it a product's last edge.
Claude spreads across the whole design team (Utila) while Figma showcases its MCP partners in its quarterly earnings.

syntheses.titre: A design system that blocks nothing is just a suggestion
syntheses.texte: Florian Gampert is blunt: if nothing breaks when a team ignores the system, it is a suggestion, and coding agents skip it even faster than people do. Kitty Brown confirms it from the field: even with JSON context, an agents.md and a second checking agent, AI follows the system 90-95% of the time and still slips in hard-coded values. Hasib R. reaches the same conclusion on a 50-page site: the result holds thanks to strict rules (BEM, variables), then a manual polish. All three agree: the tool must enforce the rule, and humans check the rest.

syntheses.titre: The design system becomes the antidote to generic output
syntheses.texte: The Human Layer starts from one observation: when everyone builds fast with the same tools, only quality is left, and a design system is the cheapest way to get it. Julian Oczkowski demonstrates it in Claude Design: same prompt, a generic page without a system, an on-brand page with one. Nick Babich lists Claude Code repos heading the same way, including design.how to maintain and apply a system. Common thread: AI needs your decisions, including what you don't do.

syntheses.titre: Claude becomes the whole design team's tool, not just the prototype's
syntheses.texte: At Utila, Alina Khazanova describes Claude as a project partner: internal guides, skills synced with the design system, specs sent back into Figma via MCP, project plans next to the prototype. Nick Babich gets 521 reactions on a simple list of repos for designers, a sign of strong demand. Alissa Condra points to the flip side: the tool changes so fast that her tutorials expired in three months, while UX judgment stays.

syntheses.titre: MCP leaves the workshop and enters the platforms
syntheses.texte: Optimizely is among the new MCP partners Figma presented with its earnings, with an agent that uses design context for A/B tests and CMS pages. Hasib R. combines Figma MCP, Bricks MCP and Claude Code to ship a 50-page WordPress site, and Utila sends its specs back into Figma the same way. MCP is becoming a standard pipe between design and production, but every account stresses the instructions you have to provide.

syntheses.titre: Design the agent at the workflow level, with human checkpoints
syntheses.texte: Dhruv Sood criticizes the agent dropped into a sidebar while the user still does all the work: design the full flow, give every step an owner and document every handoff. Alissa Condra keeps the same idea for her own use: hand a task over when it repeats or produces a deliverable, and keep human approvals where mistakes are costly.

posts.role: Design Systems Architect, unified 12 brands across 86 countries
posts.idee: An unenforced system is a suggestion. "Please use" docs, a Figma library you can detach in one click, a "looks right" review: it all relies on people remembering, and coding agents ignore it even faster.
concret: The build fails on a raw colour
The linter flags a local copy of a shared button
The PR can't merge until an exception has an owner
People and agents hit the same rule
posts.commentaires: He closes with a question: what in your setup actually complains today?

posts.role: Design Systems Lead, design systems built for agents
posts.idee: AI follows the system 90-95% of the time, no more. She builds components code-first in Claude Code or Cursor, then pushes them to Figma via MCP to check the remaining 5-10%.
concret: Component context in JSON
Harness layer via an agents.md file
Second agent (Jev) to double-check
Errors seen: broken colour and spacing scales, hard-coded values instead of tokens
Testing components together, across screens and breakpoints
posts.commentaires: 14 comments, mostly agreeing that manual polish is still needed.

posts.idee: Claude becomes the design team's project partner. Beyond brainstorming and prototypes, the team uses it to keep large projects on track, document its thinking and send specs back into Figma.
concret: Internal guides on progress and workflows
Custom skills synced with the design system between Claude and Figma
Brand hub: guidelines, templates, tooling
Interactive canvas-style diagram for a complex flow
Project plan artifact next to the prototype: scope, assumptions, feedback, open questions

posts.idee: Same prompt, two results. Without a design system, Claude Design returns a generic white page; with one, the page uses the brand's fonts, colours and buttons.
concret: Step 1: + → Design system → New design system, upload brand files or sync from GitHub
Step 2: Claude turns a one-page brand sheet into tokens and components, asks about gaps and flags colour pairs that fail contrast
Step 3: the system stays selected for the next designs
Beta on Pro and above

concret: oil-ui: generates and refines UIs from screenshots
dimensional-drawing: visual component specs (spacing, dimensions)
Awwwards-mcp: inspiration from award-winning sites

Brand Identity Skill: logos, type, palettes, guidelines
Claude Code Skills for Product Designers masterclass with Packt on November 30
posts.commentaires: 45 comments, mostly designers saying which one they'll try first.

posts.role: Sr. UX Designer, Hewlett Packard Enterprise
posts.idee: An agent outside the workflow is just a renamed chatbot. In enterprise apps, an agent lands in a sidebar and users still do all the work: design the end-to-end flow before the panel.
concret: Every step has an owner, agent or person
Every handoff states what the agent tried, why it stopped, what comes next
Gemini to map steps and exceptions, Replit to run the flow, VS Code to ship into the design system
Figures cited: 87% of customers say access to a human is essential, 84% give a virtual agent three tries at most
Metrics: time to pick up a handoff, how often people start over
posts.engagement: Chapter 61 of his Agentic UX series

posts.idee: Figma puts its MCP partners in front of investors. Optimizely appeared in Figma's earnings presentation among its new MCP partners.
concret: Optimizely's "Mark" agent uses design context via the Figma MCP
Use cases: A/B test variants, CMS pages, design → implementation

posts.role: WordPress developer, Figma to live site
posts.idee: Not 1-click magic, but weeks saved. A 50-page site designed in Figma, rebuilt with Claude Code, Bricks MCP and Figma MCP, nearly identical to the design.
concret: Strict instructions: BEM classes, ACSS variables, no utilities or inline styles
Minimal wrapper containers
Manual polish: one mis-mapped image, small-breakpoint fixes
Dynamic ACF fields and query loops handled

posts.auteur: Ruksana Shaukat et Tanaka Kungwengwe (The Human Layer)
posts.idee: Speed is free, quality isn't. When everyone builds with the same tools, a well-crafted design system becomes a product's cheapest edge.
concret: Audit prompt: list colours, sizes, spacing, radii and buttons with usage counts
Start from an existing system: shadcn/ui, Material, Carbon
Write your principles in plain language, including what you don't do
Rules in a DESIGN.md read by AI tools
Figures cited: 34% faster with an up-to-date system (Figma), 22.5% lower agent costs at Coinbase

posts.idee: Tool tutorials expire in weeks, UX judgment doesn't. The most-explained slide of her Cowork talk went out of date in three months after Claude's modes merged.
concret: Timeline: Cowork and chat merged on September 16, Docs, Slides and Design on every plan on October 8
The standalone Claude Design site closes on December 14
Hand-off test: the task repeats, touches real files or produces a deliverable
Standout example: an interactive journey map built from meeting transcripts
